petrol.role: Brand identity dark forest green: logo, header brand accent, secondary navigation and editorial actions

petrolDark.role: Darkest brand surface for footer and focus outline

emerald.role: Brand green for secondary filters, guides and interactive highlights

emeraldHover.role: Hover state for brand green buttons

coral.role: Primary commercial offer CTA burnt orange ('Ver oferta na Shopee', 'Ver oferta no Mercado Livre')

coralHover.role: Hover state for burnt orange offer CTAs

coralText.role: Accessible burnt orange link/accent text on #F7F8FA and #FFFFFF

canvas.role: Main light neutral catalog page background

surface.role: Pure white card surface for offers, filters, guides and drawers

surfaceAlt.role: Subtle neutral container background for tables and secondary blocks

lime.role: Punctual layout signature accent ONLY paired with dark #143D2B ink (never white text on lime)

limeHover.role: Hover stop for subtle lime highlight

mintBg.role: Confirmed savings or valid condition pill surface

mintText.role: Accessible green ink on #F0FDF4 for documented savings/benefits

ink.role: Primary graphite ink for headings, product titles and prominent prices

inkOnCoral.role: High-contrast white text over #C2410C burnt orange primary offer CTAs

muted.role: Secondary gray metadata: store label, verification time, affiliate disclosure notes

border.role: Discrete hairline separator between surface cards

borderStrong.role: Form input and secondary control borders

typography.fontFamilyDisplay: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.fontFamilyBody: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
